name: tip-autopsy-monorepo
description: Tip Autopsy — Evidence-literacy web app for first-time Indian retail investors. We grade the information, not the investment.

scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test -- --run && npm --prefix backend run test -- --run
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
